$comment: Machine-readable rename map for the noy-db 0.4.0-pre breaking set (noy-db#994). Companion to the prose note at https://noy-db.dev/migration/2026-07-30-0.4.0-pre-breaking-set — `section` points back at it. safeGlobalReplace:true means a whole-word match of `from` cannot plausibly hit anything else in a consumer codebase, so a blanket replace is safe; false means anchor on the import specifier or call site instead and read `note` first. Rows are verified against the live surface by packages/hub/__tests__/codemod-map.test.ts. Not covered here because they are structural, not renames: §4 (23 credential methods moved onto db.team), §6 (collection generics take a named shape) and the two silent behaviour changes.

NOT a source rename — this is the store path a managed-mode vault's sealed credential lives at. Existing vaults written by an earlier version hold it at the old path and will not find it at the new one. Treat as a data migration; editing source does nothing for already-written data.
Split in two, so the target depends on what you imported: pod artifacts (write/read/header/cover) went to `/pod`, orchestration types went to `/cargo`. Resolve per import, not per file.

ADDED 2026-08-22, not in this map as originally written. The 0.4 prune removed SEVEN subpaths (`./with ./ui ./by ./on ./at ./in ./as`) and this map recorded five of them; `/by` and `/with` had no row, so a consumer importing either got no migration instruction at all. Found while re-introducing `/by` in the 0.7 line, because the un-retired guard refuses a path no earlier map says was retired — the guard was right and the map was short. Every one of its six exports (`NoydbMesh` — then `CoordinationProvider` — `WriterPresence`, `FenceState`, `DrainBarrierOptions`, `isQuorum`, `runDrainBarrier`) is reachable from `/cargo` today, verified against the built surface, so this is a clean single-target redirect.

ADDED 2026-08-22 — the second of the two rows this map was missing; see the `/by` row for how they were found. UNLIKE every other subpath row here, this is NOT a clean redirect and that is why it is unsafe to apply blind: only `WriteEvent` and `WriteHook` landed on `/cargo`. `WriteHookRegistry`, `ServiceBus`/`SubsystemBus`, and `assertCanExport`/`assertCanImport`/`canExport`/`canImport` are reachable from NO declared subpath today — they became internal with no public replacement. A consumer using those has no target to move to, and this row must not pretend otherwise.

THE trap in this release. The word has a second, unrelated meaning in noy-db — derivation rollup aggregates — which was deliberately left alone: `aggregatesRecomputed` and the public `ForgetResult` field `derivedAggregatesRecomputed` are forget/derivations vocabulary and must NOT be renamed. `scan().aggregate()` also survives: streaming aggregation is independent of the reduce strategy. Rename the exact identifiers in the rows above and nothing else.
